resolution.note: backlog triage 2026-11-07: delivery metrics owned by t-2h7c18m

title: Record delivery metrics with every merge
body:
Extend the delivery record written by `krn ship` (and its Product evidence) with review rounds, overrides, gate wall time, flaky retries, CI waits and time from first push to merge, and add `krn report deliveries` that summarises merges per lane-hour, review rounds p50/p90, overrides, flaky stalls and reverts over a window. These numbers are the product proof (ADR 0014 D2).
Acceptance: every merge through krn ship records the fields from its real evidence; the report reproduces the last week of merges from records alone.
Operator 2026-10-27 (ADR 0014 D23): include the proof measures the records can give, at least lead time p50/p90, review rounds and overrides, and cost per PR where usage is recorded.
